title: How Money Really Works, Explained
desc: Money is one of the strangest inventions in human history, and our minds were never built for it. Get comfortable and join me for a calm, 2.5-hour journey through money: the barter myth, the first coins, the stone money of Yap, paper money in China, the day money left gold, inflation, the quiet power of compound growth, loss aversion, why we overvalue what we own, money in invisible jars, the pain of paying, anchors and decoys, small chances and big feelings, saving for your future self, the scarcity mind, lottery winners, spending to be seen, whether money buys happiness, happier spending, fairness, bubbles, the tortoise and the hare, and money worries at night. We end with a calmer way with money and a slow wind-down, so you can fall asleep to the last part if you like. Educational only, not financial advice.
